verification.reason: The connected GitHub capability exposes Git object creation and read operations but not mirror Git transport or release asset upload. GitHub fetch is GET-only and cannot download binary release assets. Commit records and release metadata are preserved, but the destination does not contain source commit objects or uploaded release binaries.
